name: Runner Extras - MetaTable Cache Null First
brief: Issue #4450 bundle 1 of 2: runs FIRST and asks about bundle 2's table id, which is the lookup that caches a null for it.
description: Issue #4450. In a run with several bundles, _metaTableCache is a ConcurrentDictionary whose GetOrAdd caches the NULL that BuildNCLMetaTable returns for a table not yet in _parsedTables. The FIRST bundle can ask about a LATER bundle's table before that bundle's source dir is registered, and GetOrAdd then never replaces the entry -- so the later bundle's OWN table answers null for the rest of the process and every metadata consumer silently reports it as having no fields. Runner-specific: this is a property of the runner's one-process, several-bundles shape, which the corpus (one app set per service tier) cannot express.
